BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: Experience Cloud communities are internet-facing; the guest endpoint is reachable remotely over the network.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: No special conditions, timing, or reconnaissance required; the attacker simply accesses the exposed data.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: Guest users are unauthenticated; no privileges are needed, which is the entire premise of the rule.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: The attacker acts alone; no victim action is required.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: Unauthenticated guest access reaches org-level objects, fields, and Apex beyond the intended public boundary, crossing the security authority of the guest profile.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Sensitive object and field-level data is exposed to anonymous users.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Create/edit/delete object permissions allow unauthorized data modification.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: Delete-level access can remove records, impacting data availability.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: No exploit-code intelligence is specified; exploitation is trivial via direct access, so this defaults to the worst case.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: A clear, low-effort fix exists: tighten the Guest User Profile permissions (~15 min remediation effort).

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The static scanner deterministically confirms the misconfiguration.
